title: Vintage Mickey Mouse 37" Wrist Wall Watch Clock Disney Collectors Edition
descriptionText:
The Vintage Mickey Mouse 37" Wrist Wall Watch Clock is a unique collectors' item featuring the iconic character Mickey Mouse from Walt Disney Productions. Made in Hong Kong, this Disney collectors' edition combines the nostalgia of a classic character with the functionality of a clock. Perfect for Disney fans and collectors looking to add a special piece to their collection, this clock is both a practical timepiece and a charming décor item for any Disneyana enthusiast's home.

Untested.
